title: MACD
summary: MACD is the gap between a fast and a slow moving average of price, with a signal line and a histogram. It describes momentum, and it lags.
unreliableWhen: In sideways markets, the lines cross back and forth. After a sudden move, MACD reacts late because it is built from averages.
goodExample: Reading a rising histogram as "the fast average is pulling away from the slow one".
badExample: Taking every signal-line cross as an entry in a choppy market.

chart.lookFor: Count how many times the MACD line crosses its signal line. Then open Strong uptrend and compare.
